conclusion: Primary metric held_out.structural_similarity was unavailable (held_out suite missing from e938_role_safe_all_targets_v2 at this eval snapshot) -- classified primary_metric_unavailable, non-positive regardless of smoke deltas. On smoke (informational only): control (20 steps) reached meaningful_program_rate=0.667 (2/3), the best of the four cycles run today; the higher-step candidate (60 steps, same wall cap) regressed to meaningful_program_rate=0.333 and roughly doubled p50 latency (20430.57ms vs 11879.46ms), consistent with the extra steps pushing the run closer to the 3-minute wall cap without a quality payoff at this fixture scale.
next_priorities: Bind an eval_version/eval_suites combination that actually publishes a held_out suite before using held_out.structural_similarity as a continuous primary metric, or switch continuous primary_metric to a suite that is present (smoke)
Investigate why control's meaningful_program_rate jumped to 0.667 this cycle (seed/data-order effect at n=3, not yet a reproducible lever win)
Do not raise steps past the point where the wall cap starts truncating decode -- 60 steps degraded both quality and latency vs 20 steps under the same 3-minute cap
